description: In Manager.io (Northwind Traders business), issue a sales credit note to a customer for a returned or over-billed item. Navigate to the Credit Notes module (under the Sales section) and click 'New Credit Note'. Select customer: Ernst Handel (an existing Northwind customer). Set the date to today. Add one line item: Description: Returned Beverages — Damaged Shipment, Quantity: 5, Unit Price: 18.00. Add a reference: CN-2024-001. Save the credit note. Credentials: Username = administrator, Password = (leave empty).
